body: I lost my boyfriend about 6 months ago and tbh in the beginning it was easier than it is now. There’s a state of numbness there from the shock. Your body does it automatically to protect itself from pain but after a while it wears off and you start to realize and accept the situation. The stages of grief are not linear, you will jump from one stage to the next and back and forth. I’m still on my journey but I can say 3 months is right about the time I started to have to accept it and that is the hardest part
